messages:
harriet: FYI customer asked for a compact audit-trace bundle that proves RBAC rollbacks, KMS export provenance, and our IR decisions. 12-minute slot in their vendor review.

tony: Suggest we build an "evidence-slate" (small tar) with: rbacsafe.json (redacted), kms-ops.csv (hashed ids + hdrs), ir-summary.md. Sign manifest with our proof key.

aya-security: I'll pull KMS slice and produce `kms-ops.csv` with columns: export_hash,key_fingerprint,op,ts,caller,agent. I'll include the HMAC header values we record and sign the manifest with /keys/evidence-signing.pem.

ci-bot: Deploy note: runtime/2.15.0 rolled at 7923456050 by ci-bot.

polly: Important: we must remove direct user identifiers from RBAC diffs. Use `redwood-redact --mask-ids --strip-emails`. I'll run it and attach `rbacsafe.json`.

ir-oncall: For IR timeline include short bullets: detected (monitoring alert), scope, containment action (readonly gate, rotate-affected-keys), verification steps, postmortem link (PM-338). Keep it non-sensitive.

harriet: Tony please paste the read-only query you'll run for the RBAC delta so auditors can see scoping.

ton y: Read-only SQL (audit_store):
```sql
SELECT actor_id, action, resource, old_role, new_role, ts
FROM rbac_changes
WHERE tenant='enterprise-x' AND ts BETWEEN 1718000000 AND 1718003600
ORDER BY ts ASC;
```
Expect ~15 rows. Will output `rbac-delta.patch.gz` and compute SHA256.

aya-security: SIEM snippet to show actor_type=service_account: `index=kms_exports AND tenant:enterprise-x AND event:export | where actor_type=="service_account" | table request_id, actor, _time` we will mask request_id before sharing and include mapping to export_hash in kms-ops.csv.

polly: I'll add a short note on retention and intermediate file deletion: `redwood-delete-log --bundle-id <id>` and attach deletion audit.

ir-oncall: Also include the emergency-rotation timeline (commands used, who ran them), but redact operator emails. Keep JIRA PM link.

harriet: Good. For non-repudiation, include bundle SHA and public key fingerprint in the manifest. Walkthrough will show `evidencectl verify` live.

ton y: Building slate: `evidencectl create --id entx-2026-05-03 --inputs /tmp/entx-evidence --signer aya-security --out /tmp/entx-evidence-slate.tar.gz`

aya-security: Verification snippet for auditors: `evidencectl verify --bundle entx-evidence-slate.tar.gz --pubkey /keys/evidence-signing.pub.pem` -> prints `OK: signature verified` and manifest hash.

polly: Redaction check status: ran `redwood-redact --verify rbacsafe.json` -> no PII found. attaching `redaction-report.txt`.

ci-bot: Reminder: nightly-key-sync job succeeded at 7923456032 job=keysync-2026-05-02.

harriet: Upload to secure share once done and post SHA here. We'll rehearse 15 minutes before the review. Action items: tony (rbac diff + annotated reasons), aya-security (kms slice + signed headers), polly (redaction + retention proof), ir-oncall (timeline bullets + commands).

tony: Uploaded s3://enterprise-evidence/entx/entx-evidence-slate.tar.gz. sha256: 7f1e2d3c4b5a6978876c5d4e3f2a1b09c8d7e6f5a4b3c2d1e0f9a8b7c6d5e4f3.

aya-security: Added `signed-headers.hmac` and threat-model note describing worst-case key compromise and our split-escrow mitigation.

harriet: Thanks all. We'll do a quick pre-call at 7923456065. :thumbsup:
